tools.description: Read-only snapshot of current device telemetry / KPIs.

tools.description: Read-only SOC/solar/load forecast for the active device (~7 days). Prefer `daily` rollups (solar_wh, load_wh, surplus_wh, start/end/min SOC) and `ev_divert` (surplus hours/sessions that can support car_load_w) for week-ahead EV charging advice. Use `load_schedule` for already-planned windows. `forecast_sample` is a thinned hourly curve. `charge_ceiling_pct` is the learned multi-pack SOC plateau; `solar_calibration.actual_over_predicted` diagnoses whether the solar coefficient over/under-predicts on clear-sky hours.
tools.name: get_forecast

tools.description: Fit a learned parameter over a custom lookback and optionally save it as a sticky user override. Use lookback_hours=24 for 'last day', 168 for a week, etc. (clamped 6…1080). apply=false (default) is preview-only: runs immediately and returns the fitted value — use this to answer 'what would be a better coefficient?' without saving. apply=true persists until the user Resets the param and requires Approve unless Autopilot is on. Keys: solar_coefficient, parasitic_w, inverter_overhead_pct, charge_efficiency, max_charge_w. Not for battery_capacity_wh.
tools.name: fit_device_param
